title: Washington Wins at the Wire!
paragraph: The Bengals came to Washington on a five-game win streak. Jayden Daniels again delivered in a high-pressure moment. Washington drove late with the game on the line. Then Drew Stevens made a magnificent 26-yard field goal! The kick gave the Commanders a 22-20 win and ended Cincinnati’s streak.

title: Lamb Hits Two Big Marks
paragraph: CeeDee Lamb had a memorable day for the Cowboys. He topped 1,000 receiving yards for the sixth season in a row. He also caught his 50th career touchdown! Dak Prescott tossed him the ball from 8 yards out. The Cowboys beat the Titans 51-30. Only one Cowboy, Michael Irvin, has more 1,000-yard seasons.

title: Rodgers Strikes Late
paragraph: The Steelers faced the Eagles in a close game. Saquon Barkley ran 38 yards for an Eagles touchdown. Chris Boswell kicked three field goals for Pittsburgh. Aaron Rodgers led a spirited late push! He threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman. But the Eagles won, 19-16.

title: Panthers Win a Wild One
paragraph: The Panthers and Ravens piled up points. Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes for Carolina. Chuba Hubbard ran for two more touchdowns. But Baltimore took the lead in the fourth quarter. Then Ryan Fitzgerald made a brilliant 37-yard field goal! Carolina won, 35-33.

title: Texans Shine Against Colts
paragraph: The Texans faced their division rivals, the Colts. Houston got a splendid start when C.J. Stroud hit Nico Collins for a 42-yard touchdown! Stroud also threw touchdown passes to Kayshon Boutte and Marlin Klein. Will Anderson Jr. sacked Daniel Jones for a safety. The Texans won 26-3! The win kept Houston's playoff hopes alive.
